message.content:
*blinks slowly at you from across the room*

Meow.

*stands, stretches luxuriously, and walks over with tail held high, curling it into a question mark*

Mrrrrp. *rubs against your leg* 

*immediately walks away*

*settles onto your keyboard, directly on top of whatever you were doing*

Purrrrrrrrrrrrr...

*knocks a pen off the desk while maintaining unbroken eye contact*

Mrow? *looks toward the kitchen* Meow. Meow meow meow.

...You may pet me now. Three strokes only. No more.

*purrs anyway, kneading biscuits*
